
review_comments: nit: `defer registry.Reset()` here is a bit cleaner

`Defer` inside for loop is a little tricky.  

It will begin to`Reset` after all loops finish instead of one loop finishes.
https://play.golang.org/p/9e9qyuE64nI

Will use defer in `pkg/kubelet/kuberuntime/instrumented_services_test.go`, which is not inside loop.

It's wrapped in a function `func(t *testing.T)`, so your playground isn't an accurate representation of the flow. Defers are local to the function it is invoked in, so using a defer here should be fine.
